fact: Vaccination reports are compiled monthly at the health centre and sent to the district, where data are keyed into the national DHIS2; completeness of monthly reports received nationally was 99-100% in 2019-2024.
title: Rapport d'analyse des données de vaccination Countdown pour la Côte d'Ivoire
publisher: Direction de Coordination du Programme Elargi de Vaccination (DCPEV), République de Côte d'Ivoire
